function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[]; $('entry,item').each((i,e)=>{const x=$(e);const link=x.find('link[rel="alternate"]').attr('href')||x.find('link[href]').attr('href')||x.find('link').first().text();if(link)posts.push({url:link,title:x.find('title').first().text(),publishedAt:x.find('published,pubDate,updated').first().text()});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$(".elementor-widget-theme-post-content").first().clone(); b.find('script,style,nav,.related-posts,.post-navigation,.post-meta,.blog-posts,.upvote-button,form').remove();return {title:$("h1.elementor-heading-title").last().text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: feed RSS item列表；單篇最後一個 h1.elementor-heading-title 為文章標題，.elementor-widget-theme-post-content 正文。
